fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. CCAF foot platoons anchor the Confederation's garrison network, holding worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they depend on prepared positions and local knowledge to offset their lack of mobility. These demolition teams carry Striker carbines for personal defense while specializing in explosive ordnance disposal and structural demolition operations behind enemy lines.
